newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close shade off on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close shade off on profit-taking.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly lower as investors took profits and a breather, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.28 points lower at 607.76. Price declines out numbered gains by 25 to 19. Central Finance fell two rupees to 243, Merchant Bank three rupees to 21.
"The market has the capacity to move up to about 625 points, but not in one straight run," said Seedantha Kulatilake of Allied Phillips Securities.
Small retail investors who were largely instrumental in taking the index up from about 550 points to its current level, are taking profit and getting ready for the next lap, he said.
Turnover was a moderate 18.32 million rupees on 742,809 shares, partly due to a holiday in Hong Kong, brokers said.
The main volume of the day was 101,000 shares of Ceylon Brewery which traded unchanged at 30.75 rupees.
"The Ceylon Brewery quantity included some foreign buying which originated in destinations other than Hong Kong," said a broker with a foreign joint venture firm.
Local institutional investors had gone to the sidelines after the index showed signs of softening, brokers said. --Prithi Kodagoda (41) 434319
